page.overview:
Who is Brunskill?

Brunskill is a minor character in the 1964 film Goldfinger. He is a servant of Colonel Smithers. He is portrayed by Denis Cowles.

Brunskill served the drink and the cigar on the dinner when James Bond and M talked with Colonel Smithers, who then dismissed him.
